user.title: BLE IRK Extractor Setup
user.description:
Select an extraction or setup path:
- **Select IRK Key**: Pick a key from synced BlueZ host storage.
- **Add IRK Key**: Manually enter an IRK.
- **Extract IRK Key**: Put adapter in pairing mode to receive new device keys.

select_irk.title: Select IRK Key
select_irk.description: Select a paired device from synced BlueZ storage to set up a Private BLE Device.

irk_details.title: IRK Key Details
irk_details.description:
Extracted key details for **{name}** ({address}):

**IRK Key**:
`{irk}`

You can copy the IRK key above, or keep the toggle enabled to automatically set up a Private BLE Device.

add_irk.title: Add IRK Key
add_irk.description: Manually enter a device name and 32-character hexadecimal Identity Resolving Key (IRK).

extract_irk.title: Extract IRK Key (Pairing Mode)
extract_irk.description: Pairing mode is active on your Bluetooth adapter ({adapter}) for {timeout} seconds. Open Bluetooth settings on your phone or device, select this Home Assistant server, and complete pairing. When finished, submit this form.

extract_sync.title: Sync BlueZ Storage
extract_sync.description:
Pairing mode has been safely deactivated. BlueZ stores pairing keys on the host. To sync them to Home Assistant storage, run this terminal command on your host or SSH terminal:

`{copy_command}`

Once completed, restart this setup flow and choose 'Select IRK Key' (Path 1) to create your Private BLE Device.

paths.title: Configure BlueZ Paths
paths.description: Point the integration at the BlueZ bond data on your Home Assistant host.

data_description.name: Friendly name for this extractor.
data_description.copied_path: Folder containing BlueZ info files copied into Home Assistant. Default: /config/bluez_irks.
data_description.host_path: BlueZ host storage. Default: /var/lib/bluetooth. Leave blank if this path is not available in the container.
data_description.scan_interval: How often to reread the BlueZ files, in minutes.

pair_device.title: Pair a new Bluetooth device
pair_device.description: Select the Bluetooth adapter you want to pair through. Make sure the device is discoverable.

discover_devices.title: Select a Bluetooth device
discover_devices.description: Choose the device you want to pair with from the discovered list.

pairing_result.title: Pairing complete
pairing_result.description: Extracted IRK: {irk}. You can use it to set up Home Assistant's Private BLE Device integration.

pairing_manual_guidance.title: Manual Pairing Guidance
pairing_manual_guidance.description:
Automatic pairing could not retrieve the bond key directly. Run the sync command after pairing:

`{copy_command}`

reconfigure.description: Update the BlueZ source paths or scan interval.

init.title: BLE IRK Extractor Options
init.description:
Select an action to configure or extract keys:
- **Select / View Extracted IRK**: Inspect extracted keys or forward to Private BLE Device.
- **Add IRK Key**: Manually enter an IRK.
- **Extract IRK Key**: Put adapter in pairing mode to receive new device keys.
- **Configure BlueZ Paths**: Update host storage paths or rescan interval.
